svg.title: Spinless t-V: Hamiltonians published at one size
svg.text: Spinless t-V: Hamiltonians published at one size
Every Hamiltonian of this model with energies published at only one size and no strip to join, grouped where they share lattice,
boundary and size; the coupling or filling that differs between them runs along x. Colour is the kind of number; filled marks can
hold a record, hollow ones cannot, and a slashed mark is a flagged row.
